verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 103.5 (-0.9% in a day) and momentum is 41: prices are falling. 84s cost 700, 85s 2,100 and 86s 4,700. Champions weekend starts Friday, when demand for meta cards usually peaks.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-22T07:31:00+01:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Alessia Russo 88 after its 28% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 12,250 coins. Now 11,500. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 27.9% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This is the strategy's first tracked call. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Alphadjo Cissè 85 Star Performer after its 11% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 101,000 coins. Now 77,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 10.6% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This is the strategy's first tracked call. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Buy cards you want for Champions before Friday evening
moves.detail: Demand for meta cards usually peaks when Champions weekend starts, so buying the cards you will play earlier is usually cheaper.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,100 (1.00 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,700 (1.15 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,500 (1.18 coins per Item Score point), 88s 11,500 (1.39 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Alessia Russo and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Alessia Russo 88 Rare -31.3%; Alphadjo Cissè 85 Star Performer -30.6%; Tabitha Chawinga 87 Rare -26.3%; Désiré Doué 86 Rare -25.4%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Cora Zicai SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 32.3K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
